title: Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi Day.
bodyText: October 2 of each year shall be known and designated as "Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi Day"; provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-16.2]  Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi Day.  October 2 of each year shall be known and designated as "Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi Day"; provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 2015, c 5, §2]
